"""Share completed original/public receipt copies; retain all paths and bytes."""
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import hashlib,json,os,shutil,stat,sys
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
R=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');Q=R/'.cache/v185-completed-public-receipt-storage-v2'
NAMES=['v157-spatial-rgb','v158-regional-dc','v159-regional-dc-transition','v160-paired-response',
 'v161-harmonic-context','v162-flat-target-anchor','v164-pair-unit-floor','v165-pair-common',
 'v166-common-support-routing','v167-bounded-support','v168-fine-mesh','v169-balanced-spatial',
 'v171-matching-residual','v172-local-noise-matching','v173-weak-gradient-matching','v174-spread-matching',
 'v175-fresh-noise-matching','v178-phase-evidence','v180-local-phase-evidence','v181-flat-spatial-evidence','v183-coherent-pair-evidence']
def ref(p):
 p=Path(p).absolute()
 with p.open('rb') as f:h=hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
 return {'path':str(p),'sha256':h}
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def save(p,x):
 with p.open('x') as f:json.dump(x,f,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
def stamp():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('America/Los_Angeles')).isoformat()
def obs(p):
 s=p.lstat();assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==os.getuid() and not p.is_symlink()
 return {n:getattr(s,'st_'+n) for n in ['dev','ino','size','blocks','mode','uid','gid','nlink','mtime_ns','ctime_ns']}
def terminal(o):
 try:p=psutil.Process(o['pid']);return p.create_time()!=o['created'] or p.status() in [psutil.STATUS_ZOMBIE,psutil.STATUS_DEAD]
 except psutil.NoSuchProcess:return True
def root_for(p):
 parts=p.parts
 for index,part in enumerate(parts):
  if part.startswith('V') and part[1:2].isdigit():return Path(*parts[:index+1])
 raise ValueError(p)
def plan():
 assert not Q.exists();Q.mkdir()
 rows=[];publications=[];roots=set();bound=[];owners=[]
 for n in NAMES[:12]:
  index=R/f'docs/results/{n}-final-v1.json';d=read(index)
  assert d['status'].startswith('completed-'),(index,d['status'])
  manifest=d['figures'];assert ref(manifest['path'])==manifest
  publications.append(ref(index));bound.append(manifest)
  for item in d['copies'].values():
   if not isinstance(item,dict) or not all(k in item for k in ['original','public']):continue
   a,b=Path(item['original']['path']),Path(item['public']['path'])
   if not (a.is_relative_to(R/'.cache') and b.is_relative_to(R/'docs/results')):continue
   if a.stat().st_size < 2**20:continue
   sa,sb=obs(a),obs(b);roots.add(root_for(a))
   if sa['nlink']!=1 or (sa['dev'],sa['ino'])==(sb['dev'],sb['ino']):continue
   assert (sa['dev'],sa['mode'],sa['uid'],sa['gid'],sa['size'])==(sb['dev'],sb['mode'],sb['uid'],sb['gid'],sb['size'])
   assert item['original']['sha256']==item['public']['sha256']
   assert ref(a)==item['original'] and ref(b)==item['public']
   assert obs(a)==sa and obs(b)==sb
   rows.append({'publication':ref(index),'original':item['original'],'public':item['public'],'before_original':sa,'before_public':sb})
 for root in roots:
  for p in root.glob('*launch*.json'):
   x=read(p)
   if isinstance(x,dict) and 'owner' in x and isinstance(x['owner'],dict) and set(x['owner'])>={'pid','created'}:
    assert terminal(x['owner']),(p,x['owner'])
    owners.append({'launch':ref(p),'owner':x['owner'],'observed_terminal':True})
 for proc in psutil.process_iter(['pid','cmdline']):
  try:
   command=' '.join(proc.info['cmdline'] or [])
   assert not any(str(root)+'/' in command for root in roots),(proc.pid,command)
  except (psutil.NoSuchProcess,psutil.AccessDenied):pass
 save(Q/'plan-v1.json',{'status':'read-only-full-byte-hash-plan-for-completed-receipt-copy-sharing','created_local':stamp(),
  'rows':rows,'publications':publications,'manifest_bindings':bound,'trial_roots_observed_without_active_command':[str(p) for p in sorted(roots)],
  'terminal_launch_owners':owners,'previous_duplicate_allocated_bytes':sum(512*r['before_original']['blocks'] for r in rows),
  'free_before':shutil.disk_usage(R).free,'source':dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
  'scope':'Only explicit original/public publication receipt copies from12 completed V157/158/159/160/161/162/164/165/166/167/168/169 publications;not capture/JPEG/source/native/checkpoint files. Full equal publication-bound hashes and same filesystem/user/mode before atomic hardlinks. Every path/byte retained;before inode/mtime metadata recorded. Old roots have no active command and recorded launch owners observed terminal. New V184 work and unavailable original/dataz media untouched. No previous storage consolidation rerun.'})
 print('PLAN',len(rows),'completed receipt pairs',sum(512*r['before_original']['blocks'] for r in rows)/2**20,'MiB prior duplicate allocation;',len(owners),'terminal launch owners')
def apply():
 p=read(Q/'plan-v1.json');assert ref(__file__)['sha256']==p['source']['sha256'];assert not (Q/'result-v1.json').exists()
 for item in p['terminal_launch_owners']:assert ref(item['launch']['path'])==item['launch'] and terminal(item['owner'])
 for b in p['publications']+p['manifest_bindings']:assert ref(b['path'])==b
 for row in p['rows']:
  a,b=Path(row['original']['path']),Path(row['public']['path'])
  assert obs(a)==row['before_original'] and obs(b)==row['before_public']
  assert ref(a)==row['original'] and ref(b)==row['public']
  temp=a.with_name('.'+a.name+'.v184-png-copy-v1.tmp');assert not temp.exists()
  os.link(b,temp);os.replace(temp,a)
  assert ref(a)==row['original'] and ref(b)==row['public'] and a.stat().st_ino==b.stat().st_ino
 for b in p['publications']+p['manifest_bindings']:assert ref(b['path'])==b
 result={'status':'pass-completed-render-copy-storage-all-paths-and-receipt-bytes-preserved','created_local':stamp(),
  'plan':ref(Q/'plan-v1.json'),'source':p['source'],'rows':p['rows'],'pairs':len(p['rows']),
  'terminal_launch_owners_checked':len(p['terminal_launch_owners']),'trial_roots_without_active_commands':p['trial_roots_observed_without_active_command'],
  'previous_duplicate_allocated_bytes':p['previous_duplicate_allocated_bytes'],'free_before':p['free_before'],
  'free_after':shutil.disk_usage(R).free,'scope':p['scope']}
 save(Q/'result-v1.json',result);save(R/'docs/results/v185-completed-public-receipt-storage-v2.json',result)
 print('PASS',len(p['rows']),'receipt pairs;local free GiB',shutil.disk_usage(R).free/2**30)
if __name__=='__main__':
 assert sys.argv[1] in ['plan','apply']
 plan() if sys.argv[1]=='plan' else apply()

scope: Only explicit original/public publication receipt copies from12 completed V157/158/159/160/161/162/164/165/166/167/168/169 publications;not capture/JPEG/source/native/checkpoint files. Full equal publication-bound hashes and same filesystem/user/mode before atomic hardlinks. Every path/byte retained;before inode/mtime metadata recorded. Old roots have no active command and recorded launch owners observed terminal. New V184 work and unavailable original/dataz media untouched. No previous storage consolidation rerun.
